explication: This Neovim plugin updates `commentstring` to match the language at the cursor, using Tree-sitter queries—particularly useful in files with embedded or nested languages. The documented workflow is setup, cursor-context detection, then updating Neovim’s option; without an integration, calculation occurs on `CursorHold`. Commenting integrations can trigger calculation when needed, but the available excerpts do not show their implementation or internal call paths.
